problem: Consider the collection of point masses ${m}_{1}=5\,\text{kg},$ ${m}_{2}=1\,\text{kg},$ ${m}_{3}=2\,\text{kg},$ and ${m}_{4}=4\,\text{kg}$ located at ${x}_{1}=1,$ ${x}_{2}=4,$ ${x}_{3}=0.5,$ and ${x}_{4}=1.5,$ respectively, along the $x$-axis, where the $x$-coordinates are measured in meters. What is the $x$-coordinate of the center of mass for this system?

examples.knowledge_point: Calculating the Center of Mass for a Collection of Masses Along the X-Axis
examples.problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14033857/assets/cea41dc5efa961e4d0e3ccf42db21113d3b7d1d2240f3edbcc4c1f0cab61ead1.png)

Consider the collection of point masses above, where the $x$-coordinates are measured in meters. What is the $x$-coordinate of the center of mass for this system?
examples.worked_solution:
The center of mass, denoted $\overline{x},$ of a collection of point masses $m_1,m_2,\ldots,m_n$ located at $x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_n$ along the $x$-axis is given by 

$$
\overline{x} = \dfrac{M_O}{m},
$$

 

where 

- $\displaystyle m = \sum\limits_{i=1}^n m_i$ is the total mass of the system,

- $\displaystyle M_O = \sum_{i=1}^n m_i x_i$ is the total moment of the system about the origin $O.$

In our case, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{m}_{1} & =2, & \,{m}_{2} & =4, & \,{m}_{3} & =3, \\ {x}_{1} & =-1, & \,{x}_{2} & =2, & \,{x}_{3} & =4.\end{aligned}
$$

So, the total mass of the system is

$$
\begin{aligned}m & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{m}_{i} \\  & ={m}_{1}+{m}_{2}+{m}_{3} \\  & =2+4+3 \\  & =9\end{aligned}
$$

and the total moment of the system about the origin is

$$
\begin{aligned}{M}_{O} & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{m}_{i}{x}_{i} \\  & ={m}_{1}{x}_{1}+{m}_{2}{x}_{2}+{m}_{3}{x}_{3} \\  & =2\cdot (-1)+4\cdot 2+3\cdot 4 \\  & =-2+8+12 \\  & =18.\end{aligned}
$$

 

Therefore, 

$$
\overline{x} = \dfrac{M_O}{m} = \dfrac{18}{9}=2.
$$

Consider the collection of point masses shown above, where the distances along the $x$-axis are measured in meters. Find the total moment of this system about the origin.
feedback.worked_solution:
The moment about the origin $O$ of a collection of masses ${m}_{1},{m}_{2},…,{m}_{n}$ located at ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},…,{x}_{n}$ along the $x$-axis is given by 

$$
{M}_{O}={\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{m}_{i}{x}_{i}.
$$

In our case, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{m}_{1} & =1, & \,{m}_{2} & =4, & \,{m}_{3} & =3, & \,{m}_{4} & =1, \\ {x}_{1} & =-2, & \,{x}_{2} & =-1, & \,{x}_{3} & =3, & \,{x}_{4} & =5.\end{aligned}
$$

We calculate the total moment of this system about the origin as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{M}_{O} & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{m}_{i}{x}_{i} \\  & ={m}_{1}{x}_{1}+{m}_{2}{x}_{2}+{m}_{3}{x}_{3}+{m}_{4}{x}_{4} \\  & =1\cdot (-2)+4\cdot (-1)+3\cdot 3+1\cdot 5 \\  & =-2-4+9+5 \\  & =8\end{aligned}
$$

 

Therefore, the total moment of the system is $8\,\text{kg}\cdot \text{m}.$
